thread:
ana: Quick sync — drafting the Q3 devex roadmap. Goal: improve SDK parity, ship a curated quickstart catalog, and produce 2 opinionated sample apps (payments + semantic-search). Need to align on prioritization and launch criteria. Who's in for a rapid triage?

kevin_pm: +1. Customer asks keep coming for Python/TS parity and an out-of-the-box quickstart for integrations teams. Proposal: priority order = SDK parity -> quickstarts -> sample apps.

sara_devex: Recommend we scope quickstarts as 3 tiers: 1) tiny (1-file hello), 2) tutorial (step-by-step), 3) reference app (full infra). Ship at least one tier-2 for both payments/search at GA.

mike: For SDK parity, what's the minimum acceptance criteria? Tests + lint + published package? Also need CI publishing keys sorted.

ana: (typo, meant ana) Acceptance criteria suggestion: SDKs: unit tests (>=80% critical paths), sample snippet in README, published package to npm/pypi, 2 integration smoke tests against hosted API. Quickstarts: reproducible in <15m, CI deploy script, short video (1-2min).

kevin_pm: That feels reasonable. Add accessibility of docs: a single-page quickstart with copy-paste tokens redacted, and a one-click deploy option for public demo (deploy-bot will create ephemeral stacks).

olivia_design: Design ask: we need consistent headings, a 2-step visual template for quickstarts, and a single hero screenshot for marketing. I'll push a Figma starter kit by EOD Wed.

mike: Dependencies: infra for demo deploy, billing-safe demo token, and legal signoff for sample data. Who owns the demo token flow? @sara_devex?

sara_devex: I can own the demo token flow. Will coordinate with infra and security. Blocking item: on-prem quickstarts need a non-cloud path — mark as stretch.

kevin_pm: OKR proposal (draft): Objective: Make developer onboarding 2x faster for first-time SDK users. Key results: 1) 30% reduction in time-to-first-sample-run; 2) 3 quickstarts published (payments, search, chat); 3) SDK parity >= v1 across Python/TS + sample coverage. Thoughts?

ana: (ana) Add KR for docs quality: NPS > 4.0 on quickstart feedback form. Also KR for CI coverage >= 70% on core SDK logic.

mike: Timeline ask: can we target soft-launch in 6 weeks for tier-1 quickstarts and parity surfaces? And GA (with sample apps) in 12 weeks?

kevin_pm: 6w soft-launch okay if we cut scope: only Python + TS minimal SDKs, 2 tier-1 quickstarts, and one sample app MVP (payments). Everything else goes to phase 2.

olivia_design: I'll draft the quickstart visual template this week.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: demo-stack-staging.ETA 18m — will post IP when ready.

ana: Action items recap: 1) SDK owners (mike/ana) — finalize parity checklist + CI keys (due 1 week). 2) sara_devex — demo token flow + quickstart runner (due 10 days). 3) olivia_design — visual template + screenshots (due 4 days). 4) kevin_pm — finalize OKRs and prioritization doc (due 3 days). 5) infra — allocate ephemeral demo infra for 6-week runway (ask infra in #eng-infra).

kevin_pm: Scheduling: 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am to finalize scope. I'll send calendar invite. If anyone has hard blockers, drop them here before 9am.

mike: Adding one small tech note: prefer to publish typed SDKs with example config like:```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2' })
```
Keep examples copy-paste friendly.

ana: Great. Thanks everyone — will update the roadmap doc after the sync and pin the action-items.
